newsitem.title: USA: First Washington Realty to buy six centers.
newsitem.headline: First Washington Realty to buy six centers.

text.p: First Washington Realty Trust Inc said Friday that it will acquire six additional supermarket-anchored shopping centers in the Chicago metropolitan area for a total price of about $67 million.
The price for the properties is to be paid in a combination of cash, the assumption of existing mortgage financing, and the issuance to the sellers of equity units in First Washington.
The sellers are members of the family of the late Dominick DiMatteo, the founder of the Dominick's food store chain.
Four of the centers are anchored by Dominick's supermarkets and two of the centers are anchored by Omni supermarkets, also owned by Dominick's Supermarkets Inc.
The six properties contain about 760,000 square feet of gross leasable area and will bring to 47 the number of properties owned by the company.
First Washington said it expects closing to take place in early September.
